description: Compute return on ad spend (ROAS) per campaign for March 2025 on the ad platform. spend = sum of daily spend rows in March; revenue = sum of conversion revenue with conversion_ts in March (UTC); roas = revenue / spend. Campaigns with spend but no conversions have revenue = 0 and roas = 0. Campaigns with conversions but zero or missing spend have spend = 0 and roas = NULL. Every campaign that has spend or conversions in March appears exactly once. Output columns: campaign_name (STRING), spend (FLOAT64), revenue (FLOAT64), conversions (INT64), roas (FLOAT64, 2 decimals). Sort by campaign_name.

spend_date.description: Day of spend; one row per campaign per day with spend

edge_cases: Campaign with 2 spend rows and 3 conversions must not be cross-multiplied
Conversion on a day without spend still counts toward the month
Zero spend must produce NULL roas rather than a division error
Campaigns with neither spend nor conversions in March are omitted
common_failure_modes: FM1: Joining ad_spend and conversions directly on campaign_id creates a 2 x 3 fan-out (spend 600, revenue 800)
FM1: Joining on (campaign_id, date) drops conversions that occur on days without spend
FM7: Plain division instead of SAFE_DIVIDE fails for campaigns with zero spend
